# MinHook 1.3.4

Vendored production dependency from https://github.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook/tree/v1.3.4.
Only the library headers, sources and license are included. The build compiles
the x64 decoder; upstream source files are unmodified. No tests or examples are
part of the application. See `LICENSE.txt` for MinHook and HDE license notices.
